FN-OZ1PMW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 39 as introduced would provide one additional circuit court judgeship in the 19th,
23rd, and 28th Judicial Circuits. According to the Administrative Office of Courts, this would
increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $1.01 million for fiscal year
2025 and a minimum of $1.35 million for fiscal years 2026 through 2031.

FN-OZ1PMW-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/03/2023
Senate Bill 39 as reported by the Committee on the Judiciary would increase the obligations of
the Administrative Office of Courts (AOC), funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated
$2.1 million for fiscal year 2025 and an estimated minimum of $2.9 million each fiscal year
thereafter, to create 4 additional circuit judgeship (one each in the 11th, 19th, 23rd, and 28th
Judicial Circuits) and 3 additional district judgeships (one each in Baldwin, DeKalb, and Mobile
Counties).
In addition, this bill would further increase the obligations of AOC, funded by the State General
Fund, by an estimated $1.9 million for fiscal year 2027 and an estimated minimum of $2.5
million each fiscal year thereafter to create 4 additional circuit judgeships (one each in the 6th,
19th, 28th, and 37th Judicial Circuits) and two additional district judgeships (one each in
Madison and Shelby Counties).
Further, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of AOC to comply with the
reporting requirements provided in this bill.

FN-OZ1PMW-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/15/2023
Senate Bill 39 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Administrative Office
of Courts (AOC), funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated $2.1 million for fiscal year
2025 and an estimated minimum of $2.9 million each fiscal year thereafter, to create four
additional circuit judgeship (one each in the 11th, 19th, 23rd, and 28th Judicial Circuits) and
three additional district judgeships (one each in Baldwin, DeKalb, and Mobile Counties).
In addition, this bill would further increase the obligations of AOC, funded by the State General
Fund, by an estimated $1.9 million for fiscal year 2027 and an estimated minimum of $2.5
million each fiscal year thereafter to create four additional circuit judgeships (one each in the
6th, 19th, 28th, and 37th Judicial Circuits) and two additional district judgeships (one each in
Madison and Shelby Counties).
This bill would set a moratorium on the reallocation of judges by the Judicial Resources
Allocation Commission, until January 1, 2027, for reallocating vacant judgeships.
Further, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of AOC to comply with the
reporting requirements provided in this bill.
